title: MACP HTTP Error Body
description: Body of a request-level error in the HTTP binding (RFC-MACP-0006 §4.5), and the data of a fatal `event: error` server-sent event (§4.3): an object whose `error` member is the canonical JSON form (RFC-MACP-0001 §10) of MACPError. The `error` subschema matches schemas/json/macp-error.schema.json, tightened to require an UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code (registries/error-codes.md). Unrecognized members are allowed at both levels, because receivers MUST ignore them (RFC-MACP-0001 §10.6).

code.description: Error code from registries/error-codes.md. The HTTP status of the response is that code's HTTP Status column.

message.description: Human-readable message. Text may vary across implementations.

session_id.description: Session the error relates to, or "".

message_id.description: Message the error relates to, or "".

details.description: MACPError.details as base64 (RFC-MACP-0001 §10.3). For HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE on a subscribe resume it encodes the UTF-8 JSON text {"lowest_available_sequence": N} (RFC-MACP-0006 §3.2).
